description: Get a full-page PNG image of one URL, rendered in a real headless browser, when you need to see the page rather than read its text. Use when layout, charts or visual proof matter; for text content use alterlab_scrape. Cost: $0.004 per screenshot (browser tier). Use wait_for to wait for an element and wait_until to control load timing. Pass actions (for example dismiss_consent or evaluate) to prepare the page; the screenshot is captured after they run and action_results is returned. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

actions.description: Browser actions run in order after the page loads, before content extraction and any screenshot or PDF capture. Requires a rendered page; render_js defaults to true when actions are given. Selectors are CSS, or XPath when prefixed with '//' or 'xpath='. Failed actions are skipped and the sequence continues. The screenshot is captured after the actions run, and action_results is returned alongside it.
